players.bio: Alberth Josué Elis Martínez (born 12 February 1996), nicknamed La Panterita (The Little Panther), is a Honduran professional footballer who plays as a forward or winger for Liga Portugal 2 club Marítimo and the Honduras national team.

Alexandre 'Alex' Miguel Barros Soares (born 1 March 1991) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays for C.S. Marítimo as a midfielder. Football career Born in Lisbon, Soares played youth football with four local clubs, including S.L. Benfica from ages 10–16. He made his senior debuts with Clube de Futebol Esperança de Lagos, in the fourth division.

Alfonso Pastor Vacas (born 4 October 2000) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Rio Ave. Born in Bujalance, Seville, Andalusia, Pastor joined Sevilla FC's youth setup in 2013, after representing Séneca CF and AD FB de Bujalance. On 1 September 2018, while still a youth, he renewed his contract until 2021.
António Manuel Pereira Xavier (born 6 July 1992) is a Portuguese footballer who plays for C.S. Marítimo as a forward.
Nuno Miguel Pereira Sousa, commonly known as Briguel (born 8 March 1979), is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays for C.S. Marítimo as a right back.
Bruno Vieira Gallo de Oliveira or simply Bruno Gallo (born May 7, 1988 in Niterói), is a Brazilian Central midfielder. He currently plays for C.S. Marítimo.

Bryan Michael Limbombe Ekango (born 14 May 2001) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a left winger for Eredivisie club Heracles Almelo. Club career On 26 August 2017, Genk announced that 16-year-old Limbombe had signed his first professional contract with them, as he left the youth academy of Zulte Waregem

Cristiano Pinto Vasconcelos (born 10 July 1989 in Funchal) is a Portuguese footballer who plays for Marítimo B as a defender. Football career On 18 May 2013, Vasconcelos made his professional debut with Marítimo B in a 2012–13 Segunda Liga match against Aves.

José Edipo Deodato dos Santos or Ebinho for short (born 18 January 1988 in Guarabira, Paraíba) is a Brazilian professional footballer, who plays as a Forward. On 22 July 2014, Ebinho signed a three-year contract with Marítimo.

José Edgar Andrade Costa (born 14 April 1987) is a Portuguese footballer who plays for C.S. Marítimo as a forward or winger. Football career Born in Câmara de Lobos, Madeira, Costa finished his football formation with local C.F. União, making his senior debuts in 2006 with the club and going on to play with it in three third division seasons. In the 2009 summer he joined neighbouring C.D.

Félix Andrés Micolta or Félix Micolta for short (born 30 November 1989 in El Charco, Colombia) is a Colombia]]ian professional footballer, who plays as a midfielder. Félix Micolta plays for Marítimo, on loan of two-years from Atlético Nacional.
Fernando José Almeida Sequeira Ferreira (born 20 November 1986 in Viseu) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays for C.S. Marítimo as a defensive midfielder.
Francisco Barbosa "Fran" Vieites (born 7 May 1999) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Leicester City.
Gábor Szalai (born 9 June 2000) is a Hungarian football defender who plays for Nemzeti Bajnokság club Ferencváros.

Admilson Estaline Dias de Barros (born 24 February 1988), commonly known as Gegé, is a Cape Verdean footballer who plays for Portuguese club C.S. Marítimo as a central defender. Club career Gegé was born in Santiago. He moved to Portugal in 2008, starting in the lower leagues with Sporting Clube de Pombal and C.F. Estrela da Amadora and moving to the second division in June 2010, signing for C.D.
Ibrahim Akitunde Alani Listenⓘ(born 29 July 2006) is a Nigerian footballer who plays as a midfielder for Portuguese club Marítimo.

João Diogo Gomes de Freitas (born 28 February 1988), known as João Diogo, is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays for C.S. Marítimo as a right back. Football career Born in Funchal, João Diogo joined local C.S. Marítimo's youth system in 1996, at the age of 6. He spent the better part of his first four seasons as a senior with the reserves, in the third division.

José Manuel Martins Teixeira Gomes (born 28 August 1970) is a Portuguese football manager, currently in charge of Marítimo in the Primeira Liga. Born in Matosinhos, Gomes started coaching in his early 20s, beginning with the youth teams of Clube Futebol de Valadares. Still in the decade, he acted as an assistant at F.C. Paços de Ferreira and S.C. Covilhã.

Erson Stiven Dias Costa (born 22 January 1993 in Santo Antão) is a Cape Verde professional footballer who plays for C.S. Marítimo as a Forward. In the 2012-13 season he made his first goal in Liga Sagres against Moreirense.

Luis Alberto Caicedo Mosquera (born 18 May 1996) is a Colombian football midfielder currently playing for Marítimo. Club career Caicedo joined Categoría Primera A side Cortuluá ahead of their 2015 season after spending one season with Sporting CP, where he made a single appearance for Sporting CP B and 20 appearances for their youth side.

Luís Miguel de Olim Andrade, known as Olim (born 27 August 1981 in Funchal, Madeira), is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays for C.S. Marítimo. A versatile defender, he can play on either flank or in the middle.
Martín Tejón Fauli (born 12 April 2004) is a Spanish footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Valencia CF Mestalla.

Maxime Dominguez (born 1 February 1996) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Major League Soccer club Toronto FC, on loan from Campeonato Brasileiro Série A club Vasco da Gama.

Ouwo Moussa Maâzou (born 25 August 1988) commonly known as Moussa Maâzou, is a Nigerien professional footballer who plays as a striker for Marítimo. Career Maazou began his senior career as a player with Niger's Army club, ASFAN of Niamey. In 2005–2006 Maazou scored 17 goals. In the 2006–2007 season with ASFAN, he scored 20 goals in 34 matches.
Nathanael Simeon Ogbeta is an English professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Portuguese club Marítimo.
Rafael Tavares Gomes Fernandes (born 28 June 2002) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Ligue 1 club Lille.

Raphael Gregório Guzzo (born 6 January 1995) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Spanish club CF Reus Deportiu. Benfica Guzzo was born in São Paulo, Brazil, moving to Portugal before his tenth birthday and starting playing football with Associação Desportiva Flaviense. In 2008, the 13-year-old joined S.L. Benfica's youth system.
Rúben Rafael Sousa Ferreira (born 17 February 1990 in Funchal, Madeira) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays for C.S. Marítimo as a full back (especially on the left flank).
Samuel Bamba (born 13 February 2004) is a German professional footballer who plays as a winger for Portuguese Primeira Liga club Marítimo.
Theo Lewis Weeks (born 19 January 1990) is a Liberian international footballer who currently plays as a midfielder for C.S. Marítimo in the Primeira Liga.
Tomás Franco Tavares (born 7 March 2001) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Primeira Liga club Farense, on loan from Benfica.
Wellington de Lima Gomes (born 21 March 1990) is a Brazilian footballer who plays for CS Marítimo.
Xavier "Xavi" Grande Sánchez (born 28 January 2005) is a Spanish footballer who plays as a right back for Portuguese club CS Marítimo, on loan from Levante UD.
Jesús Santiago Pérez (born 25 May 2004), sometimes known as Yellu, is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Italian Serie A club Hellas Verona.
